question: What’s the closest restaurant as you travel from Steinhart Aquarium, CA toward DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Campbell - Pruneyard Plaza, Campbell, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.465976 37.769485)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.933495 37.289373)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.465976 37.769485)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.465976 37.769485)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Campbell - Pruneyard Plaza, Campbell, CA

poi.poi_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Campbell - Pruneyard Plaza
